annotations.title: Search funding opportunities with full details

description: Search Raise Lens grants and tenders and return full records: funder, description, eligibility, key requirements, source, apply link and the raiselens.com page. Up to 50 results a page; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page (first 1000 matches). New listings enter these results at once with full access; otherwise tenders and subcontracts 7 days and grants 30 days after Raise Lens lists them, or 7 days before they close if sooner. Public notices are named in full at once; other listings 14 days after Raise Lens lists them, or at once with full access.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from the previous page.

deadline_before.description: Only opportunities closing on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

query.description: Search terms: what the project needs funding for.

sectors.description: Raise Lens sector slugs, such as renewable-energy. The first is used as a filter.

name: search_opportunities_full

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

date_added.description: When Raise Lens added the record.

source_url.description: The original listing at the source.
